script_nghe: Can you describe him? … He’s fifteen. … And how tall? … About one metre seventy. … What about his hair? … Short and curly. Dark brown. … What was he wearing? … A blue jacket — no, sorry, a green jacket. The blue one is his brother’s. … And where did you last see him? … Near the train station, at about four o’clock.

phan.noi_dung:
**MISSING PERSON — DESCRIPTION**

- Age: **1** ____________
- Height: about **2** ____________ metres
- Hair: short and **3** ____________
- Wearing: a **4** ____________ jacket

> **First impressions**
> 
> Research suggests that people form an impression of a stranger within about a tenth of a second — far too fast for any careful thought. Longer exposure does not usually change that first judgement; it simply makes people more confident that they were right.
> 
> This matters in job interviews. One study found that interviewers who watched only the first fifteen seconds of a candidate’s interview reached almost the same conclusions as those who watched the whole thing. Interviewers are often unaware of this. Most believe they judge candidates on their answers, but the evidence indicates that appearance, handshake and tone of voice carry more weight than many would like to admit.

**Multiple choice (6–8):**

1. According to the passage, first impressions are formed
   A. after careful thought B. extremely quickly C. after about fifteen seconds
1. Longer exposure to a person usually
   A. changes the first impression B. makes people less certain C. increases confidence in the first impression
1. The study on interviews suggests that
   A. the first seconds matter as much as the whole interview
   B. interviewers ignore appearance
   C. candidates’ answers are the most important factor

Viết **70–80 từ** mô tả một người bạn thân: ngoại hình, tính cách, và so sánh người đó với bạn.
*Tiêu chí: so sánh hơn/nhất đúng (3đ) · than dùng đúng (1đ) · đủ ý (1đ).*

writing.de_tom_tat: Viết 70–80 từ mô tả một người bạn thân: ngoại hình, tính cách, so sánh với bạn.
writing.bai_mau: My best friend is called Nam. He is taller than me and a bit heavier. He has short black hair and always wears glasses. He is the most patient person I know. He is far more outgoing than I am, so he does most of the talking when we meet new people. I am quieter and more organised than he is. Perhaps that is why we get on so well.

cham_diem.vi_sao: taller than · heavier than · the most patient (so sánh nhất với tính từ dài) · far more outgoing than · quieter and more organised than. Đủ cả so sánh hơn và nhất, dùng đúng -er cho từ ngắn và more cho từ dài.

cham_diem.tieu_chi: Từ vựng ngoại hình và tính cách (1đ)
cham_diem.vi_sao: Ngoại hình: taller, heavier, short black hair, glasses. Tính cách: patient, outgoing, quieter, organised.
Ngoại hình · tính cách · so sánh hai chiều · kết luận về quan hệ.

dang_hoc: Tính từ 1–2 âm tiết thêm -er/-est: tall→taller, quiet→quieter. Từ 3 âm tiết trở lên dùng more/most: more outgoing, the most patient.
Bất quy tắc phải thuộc: good→better→best · bad→worse→worst · far→further→furthest.
far more / much more / a bit để nhấn mức độ — nâng điểm rõ so với chỉ viết "more".
loi_thuong_gap: ❌ more taller → ✅ taller (không dùng cả more và -er)
❌ He is more tall than me → ✅ He is taller than me

speaking.de_tom_tat: Describe your best friend. / How are you similar or different? / Is it easy to make friends as an adult?

cau_tra_loi.mau: His name is Nam. We met at university, so we've known each other for over ten years. He's tall, wears glasses, and he's probably the most patient person I know.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Mở bằng tên và bối cảnh gặp nhau — tự nhiên hơn là tả ngoại hình ngay.

cau_tra_loi.hoi: How are you similar or different?
cau_tra_loi.mau: We're quite different, actually. He's much more outgoing than I am, whereas I'm quieter and more organised. But we share the same sense of humour.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: "whereas" là từ nối so sánh ăn điểm, hay hơn "but" đơn thuần.

cau_tra_loi.hoi: Is it easy to make friends as an adult?
cau_tra_loi.mau: Harder than at school, I'd say. At work relationships tend to stay professional, and everyone is busier. Shared interests help — most of my newer friends I met through cycling.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Trả lời có so sánh (harder than) + lý do + ví dụ cá nhân. Công thức cho Part 3.

cham_diem.vi_sao: Đủ, mỗi câu có mở rộng và ví dụ.
more outgoing than · quieter · harder than · busier.

meo_noi: quieter /ˈkwaɪətə/ — ba âm tiết, đừng nuốt thành "quai-tơ".
So sánh khi nói thường bỏ "than I am" thành "than me" — hoàn toàn tự nhiên trong hội thoại.
